Loading GET /api/v1/events/{id} …

Everything the store holds for one event. Two live requests render the page: /api/v1/events/{id} for the current revision and …/history for every prior one. You get the full protojson envelope, the typed detail block, the geometry on a map, provenance, and — where present — the AI enhancement shown beside the verbatim source text it was built from. The model translates the wording into plain language; it never adds facts, and every revision is kept. Replay either request yourself.
